notes.title: Update DEMO! "KAMiBAKO in 15 Minutes" game mode added!
notes.content:
Hello everyone!

Thank you for always following along and supporting KAMiBAKO - Mythology of Cube -! We'd like to announce that the game's demo has recently had an update.

[h3]"KAMiBAKO in 15 Minutes" game mode added![/h3]
We've compressed all essential game elements into a quick 15-minute game mode! For those of you new to the KAMiBAKO experience, you'll definitely want to give this new game mode a try!

We have also made the following additional updates, so if you're a returning player, be sure to check it out and let us know what you think:
[list]
[*] Added the ability to run while moving
[*] Redesign to the weapon crafting system
[*] Added a "Trade" feature to the land crafting system
[*] Added sub-quest system
[*] Improved operation stability
[*] Added character voice acting
[/list]
We hope you'll continue to enjoy playing KAMiBAKO - Mythology of Cube -!

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2081340/
